# EchoVerse - Production Robots.txt

# Allow all crawlers
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Disallow admin and private areas
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /dashboard/settings/
Disallow: /checkout/
Disallow: /payment/
Disallow: /account/

# Disallow dynamic/user-generated content paths
Disallow: /preview/
Disallow: /draft/
Disallow: /*?*sessionId=*
Disallow: /*?*token=*

# Allow important pages
Allow: /
Allow: /about
Allow: /pricing
Allow: /features
Allow: /blog
Allow: /help

# Sitemap
Sitemap: https://echoverse.com/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://echoverse.com/sitemap-blog.xml
Sitemap: https://echoverse.com/sitemap-marketplace.xml

# Crawl-delay (optional, for specific bots)
# User-agent: Googlebot
# Crawl-delay: 1

# Common bots (allow but rate limit)
User-agent: Baiduspider
Crawl-delay: 2

User-agent: Yandex
Crawl-delay: 2
